setup: Copy tests/projects/homological-algebra/src to a temporary package; rewrite manifest dependency paths to the same workspace libraries; use an initially empty cache directory.
edit: Append a closed Prop definition named packageCacheProbe to the copied Field/Tensor.ref. Library sources are unchanged.
build: Repository optimized debug profile (opt-level=2, debug assertions and debuginfo enabled).
implementation: Resolve and check packages in dependency order, retaining both states at each successful boundary.

Hash checker/toolchain identity, configuration, package source and manifest, selected module coverage, and the preceding package key. Caller source and module layout do not enter dependency package keys.

Persist semantic results together with the compressed resolver and checker state. Complete hits read results without inflating the environment; changed callers resume from a matching dependency boundary.
Preserve the DAG of shared namespace-remapping tables across serialization and deserialization instead of flattening each specialization.
Retain ordinary module checkpoints for standalone files and partial queries inside a single package. Keep ordinary diagnostic recovery for failing batches.
When the environment exceeds the serialization budget, retain a result-only package record for unchanged queries; a continuation needs an earlier restorable boundary.
observations: The edited run restored four dependency packages (462 modules) and checked only six caller modules.
The warm run checked zero modules and did not deserialize a checker environment.
Before preserving namespace-map sharing, the 512 MiB serialization budget rejected three of five package boundaries. The DAG format saved all five.
The cold measurement includes creating package artifacts. It is not a direct comparison with the earlier 93.905-second --no-cache CPU sampling run.
Phase diagnostics were enabled in all three measurements; declaration-level trace lines were removed from the retained logs.
The benchmark exercised successful environment snapshots. Final validation also covers result-only snapshots and failed restoration fallback.
remaining_constraints: Artifacts contain a cumulative dependency prefix. Changing preceding package order, contents, or selected coverage invalidates later boundaries; independent arbitrary prefixes are not merged.
Source loading, parsing and dependency selection still run before lookup.
The cache directory must be shared explicitly to reuse records across entry packages; default cache directories remain local to each entry.
Large boundaries currently require roughly 120 MiB per artifact; successive caller edits can retain multiple records on disk.
This does not measure the originally reported complete differential_forms run.

validation.cli_command: cargo test -p cli --test ref_files --offline --locked -- packages_ package_cycles separate_processes full_check_local damaged_dependency default_cache module_progress ok_ref_files ng_ref_files
validation.clippy: cargo clippy -p sema -p resolve -p elaboration -p cli --all-targets --offline --locked -- -D warnings: passed
coverage: macros, structures, reflection and source locations
shared-table composition and copy-on-write after restore
result-only package hits and continuation fallback
